info:
Remote Flow Management via ThingsBoard RPC

Methods:
- getFlows: Returns current flows
- setFlows: Replace ALL flows (use with caution)
- deleteFlows: Remove ALL flows
- addFlow: Add a single flow tab
- updateFlow: Update a single flow tab
- removeFlow: Remove a single flow tab
